name: ReNew
d:
ReNew is a leading decarbonisation solutions provider and the first Indian clean energy company to list on Nasdaq (Nasdaq: RNW). With ~28 GW of commissioned and pipeline utility-scale projects including manufacturing, we are a global company with strong Indian roots.

Founded in 2011, ReNew is at the forefront of fighting climate change by offering decarbonisation solutions through utility-scale wind and solar offerings, green hydrogen, carbon markets, and energy storage. ReNew has been a pioneer in leveraging digital technologies to accelerate the transition to green energy and address the unique requirements of the B2B segment in India, where we are the market leader. Our mission is to play a pivotal role in meeting India’s growing energy needs in an efficient, sustainable, and socially responsible manner.

ReNew is the world’s first clean energy company to be recognised as a Lighthouse by the World Economic Forum. In 2023, we were recognised among ‘Top 15 Climate Tech Companies to Watch’ by the MIT Technology Review. We are a recipient of the Sustainable Market Initiative’s Terra Carta Seal. The COP28 UAE Presidency presented ReNew the ‘Energy Transition Changemaker’ award for developing and deploying the country’s first round-the-clock power project.

ReNew’s solar and wind energy projects currently contribute to 1.9% of India’s power capacity and are spread across 150+ sites and 18 Indian states. We have helped prevent 0.5% of India’s total carbon emissions and 1.1% of India’s total power sector emissions, in addition to generating around 130,000 jobs over the past decade.

ReNew generated 22+ billion kWh of clean energy during FY25, enough to power over 6 million Indian households annually, and helped avoid 18.6+ million tonnes of carbon emissions.

From cable sizing and panel design to arc flash safety, microgrid integration, and data center resiliency, ETAP solutions deliver insight, control, and operational performance tailored to your needs even in the most regulated environments. 

Our comprehensive training programs ensure engineers, operators, and designers can fully leverage ETAP tools, enhancing expertise, compliance, and operational confidence at every stage of the electrical system lifecycle.

With AI-enabled automation, cloud-ready technology, and a unified platform, ETAP empowers accelerated digital transformation, reduces risk, and optimizes energy usage, improving the safety, reliability, and efficiency of electrical infrastructure. Trusted by engineers worldwide, ETAP defines efficiency and resilience with field-proven technology, delivering continuous energy intelligence for the complete electrical lifecycle.

Innovation Highlight:

ETAP powers next-generation solutions including the world’s first AI Factory power simulation from chip to grid integrated with NVIDIA Omniverse, enabling predictive maintenance, advanced energy efficiency, and reduced total cost of ownership.

Learn more at etap.com

STOXX and DAX indices are licensed to more than 550 companies around the world for benchmarking purposes and as underlyings for ETFs, futures and options, structured products and passively managed investment funds.  
 
STOXX Ltd. is the administrator of the STOXX and DAX indices under the European Benchmark Regulation and exercises control over all benchmark administration processes within ISS STOXX.

name: Flight Centre Travel Group
d:
Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG) is one of the world’s largest travel companies, employing 12,000 like-minded individuals – known as ‘Flighties’. 

Our story dates to 1973, when founder Graham Turner (aka “Skroo") and friend Geoff “Spy” Lomas buy a double-decker bus and take off on their first tour around Spain, Portugal and Morrocco, 3 years later forming the first business, Top Deck. After flight deregulations in the 80s our first retail "Flight Centre" stores opened in Australia in 1982, London in 1984, and NZ in 1987. 

1987 was also the year we held our first “Global Gathering” awards event celebrating our amazing people, a tradition that continues to this day. 

And in 2025 we launched our very first loyalty program, World360 Rewards! Our Australian customers now able to earn and redeem points across Flight Centre, Travel Associates, and Cruiseabout.

We’re in our 40s now and a lot has changed! With global headquarters in Brisbane, Australia, our company owned leisure and corporate travel businesses span three major regions: APAC, The Americas and EMEA. 

Our flagship corporate travel management brand, FCM, extends our reach even further through a network covering over 100 countries via both company-owned operations and independent licensees. 

With 30 brands across our global footprint, our team spans from customer-facing to internal support roles. The opportunities just as diverse – from a Travel Consultant at Flight Centre or Envoyage, to a Machine Learning Scientist in one of our tech pillars. 

Together, we live and breathe our number one philosophy, Our People, driven by our purpose ‘To open up the world for those who want to see’.  

Our values are simple and powerful - Ownership, Egalitarianism and Irreverence.  

We support our people with opportunities to help you thrive, connect, give, move and be rewarded. Our people have access to a suite of curated benefits to ensure holistic wellbeing – from mental and physical health to financial freedom.

name: Saxo Bank
d:
At Saxo we believe that when you invest, you unlock a new curiosity for the world around you. 

Discovering an intuitive desire within to actively learn, explore, and ask questions, you will engage with new companies, new communities, maybe even new countries. You could call this an appetite or passion for new knowledge and skills. We call it curiosity. Ultimately everything we do as a company is focused on getting curious people invested in the world by giving our clients more ways to make more of their money.  

We began in Copenhagen, Denmark in 1992 with a clear vision: to make the global financial markets accessible for more people. In 1998, we launched one of the first online trading platforms in Europe, providing professional-grade tools and easy access to global financial markets for anyone who wanted to invest. 

Today we are a well-capitalised Danish (EU) bank with top capital ratios and positive rating from S&P, trusted by over 850,000 clients. As an international award-winning investment firm for investors and traders who are serious about investing, our clients enjoy regulated and reliable access to over 70,000 financial instruments on our industry-leading platforms. Keeping our headquarters in our beloved Denmark, we have expanded our reach to having more than 72 nationalities employed in offices in 15 countries. 

We are proud of our Scandinavian heritage and we are committed to the values of trust, fairness, and security. We believe this gives our clients the confidence to be adventurous and curious. 
Curiosity can lead you to places you never could have imagined. When you invest, you stimulate the mind, you see new perspectives, and you broaden your horizons. Personal transformation is inevitable as you develop a sincere interest and curiosity for not only the world, but also for others. 

At Saxo our greatest hope is for everyone to become engaged, to feel empowered, and to Be Invested.

d:

Durch die Kombination von Netzplanung, Marketing und Preisgestaltung mit Technologie nutzt Flix innovative Lösungen, um bequemes, nachhaltiges und erschwingliches Reisen weltweit zu ermöglichen und neue Maßstäbe im Reisekomfort und -service zu setzen.

Über unsere Technologieplattform und die benutzerfreundliche App schafft Flix ein auf die Bedürfnisse der Fahrgäste zugeschnittenes Reiseerlebnis und verbindet die Reisenden mit lokalen Buspartnern, die den Transport bereitstellen und eine moderne Flotte mit den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards gewährleisten.

Dieses einzigartige asset-light Geschäftsmodell hat das europäische Start-up zu einem führenden und weltweit expandierenden Travel-Tech-Champion gemacht.

Flix leistet Pionierarbeit und testet alternative Antriebe mit einer langfristigen Strategie zur schrittweisen Reduzierung des CO2-Ausstoßes seiner Flotte.

Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern und Fahrgäste treiben wir den Wandel hin zur Mobilität der Zukunft voran, indem wir den Mobilitätssektor schrittweise umgestalten und nachhaltigere Reisemöglichkeiten schaffen.

name: Zynence
d:
Engineering Intelligence for the Physical World.

Zynence is an AI-native product engineering platform built to transform how physical products are designed, engineered, validated, and brought to manufacturing.

Instead of engineers manually moving between disconnected tools and workflows, Zynence brings an AI engineering workforce of 150+ specialized agents to the product development lifecycle. These agents work together across requirements and system architecture, electronics and PCB design, component selection, BOM and costing, firmware, 3D CAD and mechanical design, simulation, validation, compliance, DFM/DFA, and manufacturing readiness.

Zynence is AI-native across this entire lifecycle. Its agents don't simply assist engineers with documentation or recommendations, they generate and develop engineering artifacts across electronic and mechanical domains, including schematics and PCBs, enclosures and mechanical parts, firmware, engineering documentation, validation plans, and manufacturing outputs.

Underneath this AI engineering layer, deterministic computation handles engineering-critical calculations, while bi-directional traceability connects requirements, components, electronics, firmware, mechanical designs, validation, compliance, and manufacturing, creating a continuously connected engineering system where change can be understood and propagated across the entire product.

The result is a fundamentally different way to build physical products: humans define intent, make critical decisions, and approve. Zynence's AI engineering workforce helps engineer, calculate, validate, trace, and document the product.

Our vision is to make Engineering Intelligence the foundation on which the next generation of physical products is built.

Imagine. Engineer. Validate. Build.

Across industries, cybercriminals are posing as company recruiters using fake job postings and employment offers to trick people into providing personal information or payment. Be alert and never provide personal/financial information or payment to anyone claiming to offer a job opportunity. During the recruiting process, RSM US will never: 
 
	• Ask you for payment to process documents, purchase equipment, or for any other reason.
	• Request your banking or credit card information
	• Send you a check to purchase your own equipment 
 
If you believe you are a victim of a job scam, it’s recommended that you report it to law enforcement, contact your financial institution and notify the website in which the job was listed.

name: Enterslice
d:
Enterslice is a compliance and advisory legal platform. AI and ML do the reading, reconciliation, and drafting. A network of chartered accountants, certified public accountants and lawyers, licensed in the jurisdictions where the work lands, reviews it and signs it.

THE PLATFORM

Ingest. Statutes, circulars, regulator filings, case law, ledgers, returns and contracts, parsed to structure rather than summarised.

Reconcile. Books against returns, returns against source documents, entity against group, line by line, every figure traceable to its origin.

Draft. Replies, applications, submissions and reports assembled from precedent and your own approved formats, citing the authority relied on.

Track. Every obligation and every deadline, across every entity and every jurisdiction, on one clock.

Prove. Every version, source document and approval on an append only trail you can hand to a regulator, an auditor or a board.

WHAT IT RUNS

Audit and assurance. Corporate and international tax, transfer pricing and GST. Regulatory approvals and licensing across RBI, SEBI, IRDAI and their equivalents abroad. NBFC registration and change in control. Fintech and payment licences. Virtual and fractional CFO. Market entry, incorporation, FDI and ODI compliance. Valuation, due diligence, insolvency and debt recovery. ESG.

THE PART THAT IS NOT AUTOMATED

Judgment. A model can find the precedent. It cannot decide what a regulator will accept on the day it is filed, and it cannot sign. Every deliverable is reviewed and signed by a licensed professional, and the platform records who gave that signature and when.

That is the whole design. Machines at the volume. Professionals at the point of judgment. One system of record for both.

name: Floor5 — Interior Care Systems
d:
Floor5 is an interior care studio focused on how modern spaces are maintained, preserved, and experienced over time.

Today’s interiors are built with extraordinary materials — stone, porcelain, glass, wood, and advanced composites — yet they are often maintained using generic cleaning chemistry that ignores how these materials behave.

Floor5 was created to address this gap.

Our work sits within a field we refer to as Interior Care — the systems, materials, and practices that shape how spaces are maintained, how surfaces age, and how environments continue to feel over time.

We study how real materials respond to everyday care and develop surface-aware, naturally derived care systems designed to preserve both the structural integrity and the sensory atmosphere of spaces.

The work sits at the intersection of:

• material behaviour
• natural formulation
• surface preservation
• sensory environments

Floor5 develops interior care systems for premium homes, hospitality environments, and modern commercial spaces where longevity, safety, and atmosphere matter.
